comment: The attack and decay CVs are added as seconds directly, so one volt at a full attenuverter adds one second; the commented-out line beside each (Slewer.cpp:208 and :228) shows a tenth-scaled version the maker dropped. The two gate outputs are printed ATT and DEC on the panel, the same words as the two time knobs. The IN and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
